> But this should be performance tested with large tables (e.g., engine docs), if it's adding segnificant time to the initial shaping, so extra condition can be added to only call resize if nested tables were found during `_shape_line`.

That makes sense, I made the requested changes with the second pass.

I'll try to verify the performance changes with the engine docs. I haven't done anything like that before but I'm assuming I just have to record into a variable the ticks_msecs at the beginning and then find how many ticks_msecs elapsed by the end of it and print it, then compare the prints from before the PR was applied with the ones after, right?

Ok, I tried to measure the time difference in the _process_line_caches() method being called in the RichTextLabel for the documentation, specifically in the documentation for Node since that one is pretty big.

I opened the documentation page in an empty project and opened the editor 10 times to capture the time it took for it to process.

With the PR average 729241.8μs:
```

```
